description: Use when you need South Korea's earliest export read: the Korea Customs 10-day provisional release (days 1-10, 1-20, full month; out on the 11th, 21st and 1st). Input: optional month (YYYYMM) and period (10, 20, full); default latest. Output: JSON exports in USD with YoY %, latest 10-day increment, 10 key items (semiconductors, cars, ships...) and 10 markets (China, US, EU, Vietnam...) with YoY and share, next release date. Example: ?month=202609 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

month.description: Release month YYYYMM (default: latest release; data from 2024-09)

period.description: 10 (days 1-10), 20 (days 1-20) or full; requires month. Default: latest available for the month

name: kr_trade_exports_10day
title: Korea 10-day export flash (Korea Customs): totals, YoY, top items and markets
